description: This file defines a class `RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterStrategy` that extends `PlacementFilterStrategy`. It manages placement filtering based on specified metadata keys, including initialization and retrieval of grain properties related to metadata keys within the Orleans runtime placement filtering system.

classes.name: RequiredMatchSiloMetadataPlacementFilterStrategy
classes.description: A placement filter strategy that filters based on metadata key-value pairs for silos in Orleans.

methods.name: AdditionalInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the strategy with grain properties, extracting metadata keys from the grain property 'metadata-keys'.

methods.name: GetAdditionalGrainProperties
methods.description: Yields grain properties related to the current metadata keys as part of placement filtering.
